g.text: Board: 60 x 80 mm perfboard, 22 x 27 holes; layout in BaseBoard.kicad_pcb.

g.desc: Board: 60 x 80 mm perfboard, 22 x 27 holes; layout in BaseBoard.kicad_pcb.

g.text: U1 sits in two 1x15 female headers. Its GND pins 2 and 17 meet on the DevKit.

g.desc: U1 sits in two 1x15 female headers. Its GND pins 2 and 17 meet on the DevKit.

g.text: U2 plugs into a 1x6 female header. R1 and R2 plug into one 1x4 female header.

g.desc: U2 plugs into a 1x6 female header. R1 and R2 plug into one 1x4 female header.

g.text: Runs on the board are 0R links and solder bridges; they are wiring, not parts, and stay off this sheet.

g.desc: Runs on the board are 0R links and solder bridges; they are wiring, not parts, and stay off this sheet.

g.text: J1: 4 m FTP cable to the shield hub. Pin order on the board: GND SCK WS SD 3V3 GND drain SDA SCL.

g.desc: J1: 4 m FTP cable to the shield hub. Pin order on the board: GND SCK WS SD 3V3 GND drain SDA SCL.

g.text: Drain grounded here only; the shield hub end is cut back.

g.desc: Drain grounded here only; the shield hub end is cut back.
